activity_statements.statement: develops, manufactures, and commercializes prescription medicines in oncology, immunology, neuroscience, cardiovascular, and infectious disease for patients worldwide
designs and sells surgical devices, orthopedic implants, and electrophysiology systems through the MedTech segment (DePuy Synthes, Biosense Webster, Ethicon brands)
manufactures and markets ACUVUE contact lenses and ophthalmic surgical equipment through the Vision business
conducts clinical trials and drug development research across multiple therapeutic areas with the goal of bringing novel medicines to market
completed the Kenvue spinoff in 2023, divesting the consumer health (Band-Aid, Tylenol, Neutrogena) segment to focus solely on pharmaceutical and medical technology

name_reality_gap: The J&J name historically evoked consumer brands like Band-Aid and baby shampoo; since the 2023 Kenvue spinoff, the company is now purely a pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturer with no consumer products — the index label of 'Hospitals & Health Care' misses that J&J does not deliver care but rather creates the medicines and devices that care settings use.
extraction_notes: jnj.com main pages (about-jnj, our-business) returned maintenance errors during extraction. Profile built primarily from innovation page content and widely-known public facts about J&J's post-Kenvue two-segment structure. Segment weight estimates are approximate.
